# Recreation Prompt

Build a single-file browser-native canvas strategy game titled **Glowmask Kindred Grid** from this premise: Create a deterministic creative remix in a cyberpunk style, centered on a masked hero, but make it wholesome. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.

Preserve the source mechanics exactly: the player selects a starting node, starts play, drags from owned nodes to adjacent nodes, sends half of the source count as a traveling packet, merges with friendly nodes, subtracts/captures opposing nodes, AI opponents periodically send half-count packets, a cooldown defensive veil temporarily prevents AI from targeting player nodes, speed/pause/restart controls remain available, and victory/defeat are based on all enemies gone or no player nodes/packets remaining.

Rebuild the presentation as a wholesome cyberpunk city protected by Glowmask, a masked hero whose kindness routes rekindle neighborhood beacons. Use procedural neon skyline, mask badges, heart packets, fictional district names, readable mobile HUD, approved catalog fonts/audio/GIFs, and clear CTAs. Do not add new mechanics or change the playable loop.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: real-time graph conquest / node-routing strategy on a canvas map
- objective: choose a starting hub, send half of an owned hub's count along adjacent edges, capture all opposing hubs, and avoid losing every owned hub and in-flight packet
- input model: pointer/touch select in setup, then drag from an owned node to an adjacent target; HUD buttons control kindness veil, speed, pause, music, track, restart, and quit
- core loop: owned nodes generate counts up to a cap, player routes packets, packets merge with friendly hubs or subtract from rival hubs, captures flip ownership, AI periodically routes half-count packets, victory/defeat is checked each frame
- fail/friction state: defeat when no player-owned nodes and no player packets remain; friction comes from adjacency limits, cooldown on the veil/peace tool, node caps, AI pressure, and dimming/devastation feedback

## Protected mechanics
- Start selection must require tapping a map node before the start button activates.
- Drag from an owned node to an adjacent node sends floor(owned count * 0.5) and subtracts that amount from the source.
- Packets travel at the same base speed and resolve on arrival with friendly merge or opposing subtraction/capture.
- Capturing an enemy capital annexes that faction's remaining nodes/packets, matching the previous capital semantics.
- AI keeps its half-send heuristic, 0.5 second decision cadence, and ignores player targets while the veil/peace timer is active.
- Node production, max cap, devastation/dimming effect, speed levels, pause/restart, win, and loss logic remain intact.

## Remixed target
Glowmask Kindred Grid reframes the same node-routing conquest loop as a wholesome cyberpunk masked hero linking neighborhood beacons. Hubs become friendly districts, troops become heart/light packets, devastation becomes dimming, the peace/jammer mechanic becomes a Kindness Veil, and total domination becomes a city-wide gentle chorus. The playable graph, timings, counts, AI behavior, collision/hit detection, and state flow are preserved while the title, HUD, procedural canvas motifs, fonts, audio mapping, and presentation become a new authored public surface.
